title: PCSK9 as a Key Gene of Metastasis in Lung Adenocarcinoma: A Multi-omics and Experimental Validation Study.
snippet: Lung adenocarcinoma (LUAD) is the most common form of lung cancer. Proprotein convertase subtilisin/kexin type 9 (PCSK9) is abnormally expressed in various tumor tissues and is associated with malignant phenotypes.
